title: Candidate distinct covering system with minimum modulus 43 (Fable, 19 Oct 2026, 44-piece version)
status: COVERAGE VERIFIED ON THE FINITE KERNEL AND BY INTEGER SAMPLING; MODULUS DISTINCTNESS ARGUED STRUCTURALLY; DEPENDS ON OWENS' THESIS BEING CORRECT AND ON CODEX'S TRANSCRIPTION OF ITS SECTIONS 3.1-3.4
construction: 1. Take Owens' 2014 covering system with minimum modulus 42 (all primes through 89) and delete its unique class of modulus 42, namely 10 (mod 42) (the '2' in 7^(..., 3(2,4,3^(1,2)), ...) of Section 3.4). Everything else in Owens' Sections 3.1-3.20 is kept verbatim, including every later budget that relied on this class being covered.

2. The part of H = 10 (mod 42) left uncovered by Owens' Sections 3.1-3.4 is H' = (all 7-adic states of 3 mod 7) x C', C' = [2 mod 4 x 5-classes 1,2,3,4 and 20 mod 25] + [4 mod 8 x 5-classes 1,2,3,4 and the 5-tail (20,4)] + [8 mod 16 x 5-classes 2,3,4] + [16 mod 32 x 5-class 4], all within 1 mod 3 (density 71/4200; verified on the kernel with Codex's owens_seed_core transcription at minimum 43).

3. Cover part of H' with 15 classes whose moduli are {2,3,5,7}-smooth, at least 43, and unused by Owens (checked against the transcription's exponent vectors): 49, 98, 147 (three full classes mod 49), the arrow families 343^, 686^, 1029^ (three 7-adic digit states of a fourth class mod 49), 1372^ and 1715^, 196, 245, 3360, 6720, 23520, 47040.

4. Cover the rest of H' with 44 progressions F_i (listed below), each by its own arrow q_i^ rooted at F_i with a FRESH prime q_i in {89, 97, ..., 331} (89 is admissible because every modulus of Owens containing 89 also contains 67, and 67 is excluded from the base primes for q=89). The q_i-1 inputs of each arrow are supplied by Codex's disjoint set-building rule over the base primes p<q_i; the recorded order of base primes achieves at least q_i-1 sets. Every modulus produced contains q_i, so these families are distinct from Owens' moduli, from the spares and from each other. The design minimises the number of pieces (CP-SAT, scratchpad m43/design_ilp11.py).
5. Finitize all arrows (Owens', spare and fresh) with auxiliary primes larger than 797, one per arrow occurrence, as in Nielsen/Codex.

verification.kernel: scratchpad m43/build43.py on plan11: Owens seed (minimum 43, depths 6,4,3,3) + 14 spares + 44 pieces cover all 50,803,200 kernel states of H (0 remaining)
verification.integer_sampling: scratchpad m43/mc_check.py: 40,000 random integers x = 10 (mod 42) with x < 42*2^56, evaluated as genuine congruences (tails via p-adic digits): seed covers 29.4%, seed+spares 75.6%, seed+spares+pieces 100% (0 uncovered). Kernel-vs-integer semantics cross-checked on 3,000 samples with Codex's construction_kernel.matches: 0 disagreements.
verification.set_building: scratchpad m43/certify_orders.py: 44/44 (shape, prime) pairs reach >= q-1 sets
verification.transcription_audit: Fable re-read Owens Sections 3.1-3.4 (tmp/pdfs/owens-2014-extracted.txt) and matched every family of owens_seed_core.py in structure; the only difference is a cyclic relabelling of the five classes mod 25 inside 2 mod 5 within the seventh-prime sixth input (a tree automorphism applied consistently to that branch), which does not change the structure. The residual after the prime-7 stage matches the thesis diagrams hole by hole (hole 16 full, hole 8 only its first 5-input, hole 32 only its fourth 5-input).
verification.modulus_distinctness: Structural: every fresh modulus contains its own prime q (89 or 97..331), Owens' moduli contain no prime >= 97 and all of his 89-moduli contain 67 (excluded as a base prime for q=89), spare moduli are {2,3,5,7}-smooth exponent vectors absent from the transcription. Within one fresh arrow, Codex's lemma gives disjoint families: copies use p-exponents 1..e_p, arrows use exponents >= e_p+1, and distinct sets have disjoint families by induction. Machine test (scratchpad m43/check_families2.py): the rule was expanded explicitly with base primes <= 13, 23 and 31 for all eight shapes used (up to 8,292 symbolic classes per instance); no two classes share a modulus pattern. Full expansion is exponential (about 2^60 classes) and was not attempted.

caveats: Owens' construction (Sections 3.5-3.20) has never been machine-verified; this certificate inherits that risk.
Codex's owens_seed_core is a transcription of Sections 3.1-3.4 made by another agent; the spare list and C' depend on it.
The restoration of Owens' later budgets relies on H being covered, which this construction provides; no later-stage class was changed.
